chunks: Muhammad b. Yahya, from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Isa, from al-Husayn b. Saeed, from al-Nadr b. Suwayd, from Yahya al-Halabi, from Abu Saeed al-Mukari, from Abu Baseer — from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
regarding the words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'So they shall be flung into it, they and the erring ones' [26:94]
He (peace be upon him) said: 'They are a group who described justice with their tongues, then they opposed it by going to something else.'

key_terms.الْغَاوُونَ: the erring ones — those who are astray and lead others to misguidance
key_terms.خَالَفُوهُ: they contradicted it / they opposed it — acting contrary to what they verbally affirmed
key_terms.عَدْلًا: justice — here referring to the divinely ordained order of things, including accepting the rightful authority of the Imam
key_terms.وَصَفُوا: they described/professed — verbal acknowledgment without corresponding action

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir say about those who described justice with their tongues but acted against it in Quran 26:94?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) interprets Quran 26:94 — where the erring ones are cast into Hellfire — as referring to those who verbally profess justice but then act contrary to it. This interpretation is given in the context of a chapter on the necessity of the divinely appointed Proof (the Imam), underscoring that mere verbal profession of correct doctrine or justice, without corresponding action, is a form of deviation. The original audience of early Shia companions would have understood this as a sharp critique of those who acknowledged the Imam's authority in speech yet did not follow it in practice.
word_analysis: so they shall be flung/cast headlong

en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Yahya al-Halabi from abu Sa‘id al-Mukari from abu Basir from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following.

“Imam abu Ja‘far (a.s.) has said about the words of Allah in the holy Quran, ‘The idol worshippers, the idols, the rebellious ones, [26:94] and the army of Satan will all be thrown headlong into hell. [26:95]’
They are the people who speak about justice a great deal but in their own practice they would disregard it altogether.’”
